title: A note under a monk's skull
author: A friend below
notes: Bible 4.1 beat 8 (the Ossuary and Clatter): points the player at the apologising skeleton, true and useful. Re-read: he knows exactly who Clatter is and what he remembers, and wants the name kept quiet. Does not quote the hymn (only book-vesperine-hours may).

pages.text:
One of the dead here keeps apologising. Do not strike him. Hum something slow and old, the evening tune the monks sang, and he will sit down and listen.

He was a good gardener once. He may tell you about a pear tree; he tells everybody. It is a sweet story and a sad one and you need not trouble yourself over the rest of it.

— A friend below.
